description:
Get the status of one offloaded job, optionally waiting up to 50s for it to finish. When the job is done this already includes the worker's Summary, so you usually do not need offload_get_result.
Without job_id, lists the most recent jobs.

job_id.description: Job ID from offload_submit_task. Omit to list recent jobs.

limit.description: How many recent jobs to list when job_id is omitted.

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for completion before answering (max 50).

name: offload_get_status
title: Get offloaded job status
